description: This walk follows a popular section of the Solent Way from Lymington to Bucklers Hard. The route runs for a distance of roughly 8 miles, following the waymarked trail in an easterly direction from Lymington. The trail first passes Pylewell Park before running along the southern side of the pretty Sowley Pond. You'll then follow country lanes to Bucklers Hard where you finish on the pretty quay next to the River Beaulieu. Along the way there's some lovely coastal and countryside views with the option of continuing your walk along the river to the nearby village of Beaulieu. See the Lymington to Beaulieu Walk for more details.
